# Animal Butchering
Animals come in different sizes: large, medium, and small. Each size has its own carcass for butchering. The size of the carcass determines the number of butchering stages — small ones can be butchered in two passes, large ones in four. Each butchering stage yields different parts of the animal puzzle. Guts can be used for soups, sinews are good for binding or as a rope substitute, hides for clothing, and so on.
Below is more detail on processing the obtained components:
# Sinews They are obtained from animal carcasses after butchering. In most crafts that use rope, sinews can be used instead.
After obtaining raw sinews, you need to process them with a knife and leave them to dry for a few minutes. After drying, they can be used in crafts.
# Hide
Initially, animal carcasses yield their hide.
Hides can be scraped with a knife to get raw pelt. Scrape it again with a knife and leave it to dry for some time. After that, you get proper leather that can be used for crafting.
